input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on us, so it meets the preferred position. Section 2(a) grants a non-exclusive licence and affirmatively confirms we are "not obligated to utilize the License" and are free to acquire, develop or license competing software and services (subject only to not infringing TrueLink's IP and to our confidentiality obligations) — language that benefits us. The other "exclusive" references are neutral or in our favour: Section 8(d) is a nonexclusive licence to TrueLink of Credit Data, and Section 12's "solely and exclusively" wording is forum selection, not a dealing restriction. Section 3(i) ("Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface") is a narrow, self-triggered operational term applying only to transactions we voluntarily route through the Interface; read with Section 2(a) it leaves our procurement freedom intact and is not a requirements or sole-source covenant. Noted for awareness only, not flagged.
